sentences.en: Koalas are vulnerable to bushfires due to their slow movements.
sentences.zh: 由于行动缓慢，考拉在林区大火中处于易受伤害的状态。

sentences.en: The welcome rain has extinguished all the bushfires. Now floods are predicted.
sentences.zh: 及时的雨水扑灭了所有的林区大火。现在预测会有洪水。

sentences.en: Bushfires are a perennial menace in Australia.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚常年面临着林区大火这一威胁。
